# FDGA057

> DO use camelCasing for parameters.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.2 Naming Conventions.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE1006
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test suggestion
- Status: verified
